eyebrow: Infrastructure as Code with Terraform · Chapter 2
subtitle: Lesson 8 · Terraform Fundamentals

caption: No default = required every run. A default makes it optional.
Outputs often expose values only known after a resource is created.

code:
$ terraform output
resource_group_name = "rg-northbridge-prod"
storage_account_primary_endpoint = "https://northbridgeprodimages.blob.core.windows.net/"

$ terraform output resource_group_name
"rg-northbridge-prod"
caption: A single named output is what a script would pull programmatically.
